mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM announcement a WHERE

SELECT CAST(a.id AS VARCHAR) AS "id", a.title AS "title", a.content AS "content", a.announce_type AS "announceType", a.status AS "status", a.publish_time AS "publishTime", a.create_time AS "createTime", a.creator AS "creator", a.editor AS "editor" FROM announcement a WHERE ORDER BY a.status ASC, a.create_time DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
